mixed_velocity_followup.note: Velocity x2/x5 have both include_mixed_frame_terms and mixed_frame_transport true; finite differences are one-sided and small h is roundoff-limited.

fixed_shifted_q1e7.note: Fixed opacity, pure radiation and periodic domain; HDF Er is float32, integration accumulates in float64.

wor25_preconditioner_sweep.decision: Do not change default: more V-cycles reduce Krylov iterations but do not reduce wall time in either case.

source_trial_description.after_amr_solve: Temporary main.cpp calls pmgrd->Solve(1) immediately after LoadBalancingAndAdaptiveMeshRefinement and before NewTimeStep when gravity/resync_after_amr_trial=true.
source_trial_description.late_initialize_solve: Temporary mesh.cpp moves Mesh::Initialize initial pmgrd->Solve(1) from before hydro boundary synchronization to after the OpenMP boundary/primitive initialization when gravity/late_init_trial=true.

gravity_restart_timing_trials.decision: Both candidates leave the continuous-vs-restart discrepancy unchanged; both temporary source modifications are rejected and absent from tracked branch.

gravity_boundary_solver_trials.decision: Explicit multipole origin and tighter FMG threshold do not improve restart. MGI appears restart-identical only because divergent V-cycle rejection leaves phi=0 everywhere; invalid physical solution, rejected. Keep FMG default and original guard.

gravity_fmg_restart_repeat_option.decision: Combined opt-ins restore approximately 1e-14 restart reproducibility in local static and adaptive AMR; keep both default false and collapse production guard.
